content:
The subject of UAPs and UFOs remains in the spotlight since President Trump authorized declassification of previously classified material, and last week, David Grusch made some rather extreme comments during a sit-down with Joe Rogan. Read on to find out more.

Responsible Positions

David Grusch is not a whack-a-doodle, judging by his profile as a former U.S. Air Force intelligence officer. At the moment, he serves as Chief Operating Officer of The Sol Foundation, and until very recently, he worked as a Special Advisor to Rep. Eric Burlison. But that doesn’t mean that he hasn’t been portrayed that way.

After he started speaking out about UAPs in 2023 during the House Oversight Committee hearing, things got rather personal. Soon afterward, records concerning his mental health ended up in an article.

UFO News reported that he later sued the sheriff’s office, claiming it “violated Virginia privacy laws when they released his mental health records through a Freedom of Information Act request.” However, his $2.5 million lawsuit was dismissed in 2025.

Extraordinary Claims

It’s not every single day that mainstream media releases articles about UFOs and whistleblowers, but this week, the New York Post covered what David Grusch said to Joe Rogan.

In its article, the outlet cited him as saying “he saw a video which showed military members at a ‘contemporary’ UFO crash site that had as many as four dead alien bodies inside a crescent-shaped UFO.”

He described them as looking like “Greek gods.” After that, he also talked about “Seven-foot tall plus, gorilla-looking, scaly skin…” things. However, he also admitted that he never actually saw them himself. Still, he believed those folks who talked about them were credible.

He also alleged that some reptilian aliens survived a crash, but were later shot by military personnel. According to Grusch, one of them had killed U.S. personnel at the site. However, he didn’t witness the incident himself.

Why Do Alien Craft Crash?

Another thing that arrived during the podcast was the intriguing question that so many people ask on social media. Why do these aliens keep crashing their craft? According to Grusch, it’s because:

Some of it is [non-human intelligence] versus [non-human intelligence]…You would think, it’s like, would they get along? They’re so advanced. But we have records of them f-king around with each other.

Readers React

When the New York Post shared their article on Instagram, many people went along to have their say. One person wrote, “It truly speaks volumes if u ask me that there are people testifying under oath in congress and frankly it’s the biggest story in our known history, are we alone In the universe… An u would assume that every media outlet and news team would be covering this flat out, but no…”

Here are a few more responses from the discussion:

  • “David Grusch is a hero and a patriot, and it is too easy to mock his claims.”
  • “Same as always. Zero proof, zero corroboration.”
  • “I think he is telling the truth.”
  • “Everything he said is true it was not true why did the US government sent military to Texas in PA to keep people quiet.”
  • “He’s the only government guy I actually trust.”
